title: Household Pass Holding Step in a Repriced Protection Premium
content:
1. A second adjustment settled against the premium of a Pass and Trip Protection plan worked out afresh on the
   price the covered holding's record shows turns on how many season passes the household's own Season Pass
   Programme accounts carry for the season, counted by the entries that open a pass at its price.
2. Where those accounts carry the opening price entry of 3 or more season passes for the season, the
   household adjustment is -5.00 per cent.
3. Where those accounts carry the opening price entry of exactly 2 season passes for the season, the household
   adjustment is -3.00 per cent.
4. Where those accounts carry the opening price entry of 1 season pass for the season, or of none at all,
   there is no household adjustment.
5. Each of the percentages in clauses 2 and 3 is a percentage of the bounded premium — the premium at the new
   value once the plan's smallest and largest premium have been applied to it — and the bounded premium so
   adjusted is rounded to the cent. The percentage is taken of the bounded premium itself, never of the
   premium frozen on the plan and never of an amount another percentage settled against the same premium has
   already moved; where more than one percentage is settled against it, the percentages are added into one
   total and the bounded premium is adjusted once by that total.

*Note on the count.* The count is of the entries on the household's own Season Pass Programme accounts that
open a season pass at its price for the season the plan covers — one such entry for each pass opened.

*Boundary cases (hypothetical inputs).* Two opening price entries carry the step of -3.00 per cent; a third
moves the same household to -5.00 per cent, and a fourth and a fifth leave it at -5.00 per cent, the step not
rising further with the count. One opening price entry carries no step. On a bounded premium of 120.00 USD the
step of -5.00 per cent is worth 6.00 USD and the step of -3.00 per cent is worth 3.60 USD.
